name: X-ray lightbox
summary: Wall lightbox with a chest x-ray, white ribs on dark blue; anim on flickers the light on. For clinic scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: wall item: centred on (x, y); default y 760 is about eye height on the wall

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the lightbox is about 580 px wide and 730 px tall

params.name: color2
params.note: glass colour behind the image (dark blue)

params.name: anim
params.note: on = the light warms up from dim and flickers, then steadies

author: krakujs
